base: kernel6; PSI state machine from v5.15.222 plus targeted upstream fixes
features: System and cgroup v2 CPU/memory/IO pressure readings
Per-cgroup CPU some/full includes quota throttling and inter-cgroup competition
Threshold write plus poll/epoll notification, rearm, error and lifetime handling
Hierarchy and task cgroup migration accounting

approach: Existing task bitfield space for in_memstall
Private psi_group storage after cgroup ancestor IDs; root uses psi_system
Private last-work-function word after allocated worker; struct worker unchanged
Kernfs dispatch keyed by existing open callback; kernfs_ops/cftype unchanged
abi.evidence: 491 shared complete DWARF types have unchanged old members and sizes; supplemental header probes cover additional critical types. Not a proof of every proprietary module ABI. No complete kernel6 rq baseline.

qemu.label: psi7-docker
expected_userspace_warnings: WARNING: Support for cgroup v1 is deprecated and planned to be removed by no later than May 2029 (https://github.com/moby/moby/issues/51111)

rootfs.purpose: Kernel/module test rootfs from stock userspace; not a complete replacement for integrated kernel6-ui1 firmware. Preserve UI/RGB/collector changes during later integration.

limits: Memory PSI retains 4.19 reclaim/compaction coverage; complete file-refault/swap workingset classification is not backported.
I/O threshold registration, format and lifetime are tested; actual I/O pressure event generation is not tested.
Cgroup migration is tested; no dedicated cross-CPU stalled-task wake migration stress test.
No IRQ pressure, per-cgroup pressure on/off or later unprivileged average-based monitoring mode.
No systemd/oomd userspace installation or policy; /proc writes require CAP_SYS_RESOURCE, delegated cgroup writes follow cgroup file permissions.
No physical boot, radio/Runner tests, throughput benchmark or long soak for kernel7.

deployment.next_integration: Combine kernel7 and its rebuilt modules with previously reviewed UI/RGB/collectors, update exact-hash trial hooks and packaging gates, then QEMU-check the exact integrated image before a hardware trial.
